Container.Name: qm-companion
Container.Overview: Self-hosted companion for the Quartermaster phone app. It provides service discovery, encrypted setup transfers and an optional Docker dashboard.
Container.Requires: Install qm-socket-proxy first. Use the same QM_PROXY_KEY in both templates and a separate SECRET_KEY for Companion. The default Docker access level is read only.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Host port for the Companion web interface.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent encrypted state. Back up this directory and keep the same SECRET_KEY during upgrades.

Config.Name: Encryption key
Config.Description: 64 hexadecimal characters used to encrypt saved credentials. Generate it once with openssl rand -hex 32 and keep it for upgrades.

Config.Name: Proxy key
Config.Description: Key used to authenticate to qm-socket-proxy. Enter the same QM_PROXY_KEY used by the proxy template.

Config.Name: Server address
Config.Description: LAN or Tailscale address of this Unraid server that the phone can reach. Enter a host only, without a scheme, port or path.

Config.Name: Away address
Config.Description: Optional host name or Tailscale address suggested for away routes.

Config.Name: Docker access limit
Config.Description: Installed maximum: read, manage or shell. Keep read unless the proxy POST and EXEC settings are changed to match.

Config.Name: Bind address
Config.Description: Listener inside the container. Keep 0.0.0.0 for the Unraid port mapping.

Config.Name: Docker host
Config.Description: Internal address of qm-socket-proxy. Do not expose this port on the host.

Config.Name: Trusted reverse proxy
Config.Description: Set true only when the panel is behind a trusted HTTPS reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Marketplace bind roots
Config.Description: Optional host roots allowed for Marketplace bind mounts. Leave blank to allow named volumes only.

Config.Name: Marketplace bind address
Config.Description: Optional host address used for ports published by Marketplace deployments.

Config.Name: Radarr config
Config.Description: Optional host path to Radarr config.xml.

Config.Name: Sonarr config
Config.Description: Optional host path to Sonarr config.xml.

Config.Name: Lidarr config
Config.Description: Optional host path to Lidarr config.xml.

Config.Name: Prowlarr config
Config.Description: Optional host path to Prowlarr config.xml.

Config.Name: Bazarr config
Config.Description: Optional host path to Bazarr config.yaml.

Config.Name: SABnzbd config
Config.Description: Optional host path to SABnzbd sabnzbd.ini.

Config.Name: Jellyseerr config
Config.Description: Optional host path to Jellyseerr settings.json.

Config.Name: Overseerr config
Config.Description: Optional host path to Overseerr settings.json.

Config.Name: Tautulli config
Config.Description: Optional host path to Tautulli config.ini.

Config.Name: Jackett config
Config.Description: Optional host path to Jackett ServerConfig.json.

Config.Name: NZBHydra2 config
Config.Description: Optional host path to NZBHydra2 nzbhydra.yml.
